front.title: Card-Scheme Dispute Evidence Profile of Signed Decision Receipts

abstract.t: In an agent-initiated payment dispute, the payer, the merchant, the payment service provider and the agent operator each keep their own record of the same decision, and none of those records can be verified by the other parties. This document states that problem and defines a signed dispute receipt, registrable as the payload of a SCITT Signed Statement, that binds the decision to card-scheme dispute-evidence categories, to the agent's delegated scope, to the settlement that actually occurred, and to an evidentiary-custody record, so that parties with opposed interests can verify the same evidence offline.
